title: Teen Work and Volunteering
text:
Many teenagers around the world get a part-time job while they are still at school. Some of them work in cafes or supermarkets, while others walk dogs or babysit for their neighbours. Most young workers do this to earn their own money and to learn how to manage their time.

Volunteering is another way for young people to gain experience. Volunteers often help at animal shelters, food banks or local libraries, and they do not receive a salary for their work. Many employers value this kind of work because it shows responsibility and teamwork.

questions.text: What can the reader infer about a teenager who works part-time and studies at the same time?
options: They have no interest in school
They have to plan their time carefully

questions.text: Why might employers like candidates who have done volunteer work?
options: Because volunteers always earn high salaries
Because volunteer work is only for adults
Because volunteering shows responsibility and teamwork

working together with other people toward one goal
a duty to take care of something or someone

paragraph_translations: Muchos adolescentes de todo el mundo consiguen un trabajo de medio tiempo mientras todavia estan en la escuela. Algunos trabajan en cafeterias o supermercados, mientras que otros pasean perros o cuidan ninos de sus vecinos. La mayoria de los jovenes trabajadores lo hacen para ganar su propio dinero y para aprender a organizar su tiempo.

El voluntariado es otra forma de que los jovenes adquieran experiencia. Los voluntarios suelen ayudar en refugios de animales, bancos de alimentos o bibliotecas locales, y no reciben un salario por su trabajo. Muchos empleadores valoran este tipo de trabajo porque demuestra responsabilidad y trabajo en equipo.
